repair.content:
Restrict the small-category assertion to maps/objects for which pushforward preserves constructibility, e.g. the UC_* class already defined in2.8.9; otherwise formulate an appropriately justified large-category weight statement.

Require G continuous (equivalently F preserves compactness when source compactly generated), then apply LemmaA.4.6. Without it, retain laxness or restrict scalar objects to dualizable ones.

Replace identical copies by directsum over Gal(k_m/k_n) of sigma^*F, with the analogous conjugate sum inTheorem3.2.19.

Require a smooth surjective map, or a jointly surjective smooth covering family.

Use the multiplicative group of permitted nonzero Frobenius eigenvalues (with the appropriate Weil-weight and ell-adic continuity conditions), not only algebraic integers.
